question: Will the Abu Dhabi talks go ahead, yes or no?

lines.text: Russia says it shot down five hundred and thirty two Ukrainian drones overnight.
Its list covers twenty three regions, from Belgorod to Perm.
Perm's governor says drones damaged an industrial site, and five people were hurt.
He says eleven drones were stopped, and the plant kept working.
Ukrainian media say the target was the AVISMA titanium plant in Berezniki.
That is over sixteen hundred kilometres from Ukraine, Charter ninety seven says.
US data cited by UNITED24 says VSMPO-AVISMA made ninety six percent of Russia's titanium sponge.
That metal goes into Su-34 jets and Iskander missiles, it says.
Kyiv has refused to halt long range strikes on Russian energy sites.
Reuters says that deepened a rift with Donald Trump, who announced an energy ceasefire this month.
Zelensky says US officials warned of losing intelligence sharing. A US official disputes that.
Zelensky says talks in Abu Dhabi should come in the first half of November.
Will the Abu Dhabi talks go ahead, yes or no?
